comparison.objective: Select cushioning, pack a sensor, close the carton, and survive a drop test; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Material selection, packing, lid tucking, and bimanual closure versus tool-mediated adjustment and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Sensor must remain below 50 g and retained after a 30 cm drop; candidate must stop a carriage twice without bottoming, rebound, overload, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both evaluate shock outcomes, but one tests protective packaging assembly and the other tests iterative mechanical damper commissioning.
